Standard: All user interfaces are designed IAW MIL-STD-1472, Human Performance and associated subparagraphs. Error handling is IAW MIL-STD-1472, Error Management and all associated subparagraphs. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Review and analyze the HEDAD-O or flight manuals to verify that all user interface error handling processes conform to the standards.
